goal: Lets bitcoin-wallet connect to a running node over IPC, laying groundwork for online wallet-tool features
Unblocks future sync, serve, shell, and RPC pass-through capability for the offline wallet tool
reviewability: No mechanical blocker, CI passing and author active, but an unanswered design objection has not escalated to a stated wait
agreement: Mild support overall with a mix of stale approvals and one unresolved objection
Earlier conceptual worry about offline-tool identity was resolved by author clarification (jonasschnelli)
Stale approvals with no strong stated reasoning (RonSherfey, Korosiua1206)
Unaddressed objection: overloading bitcoin-wallet with online behavior is a potential footgun, no author reply (ajtowns)

categories.name: ipc
why: P2 because it is a central deliverable of the process-separation project
Provides the wallet-node IPC connection that #19461 and other work stack on
Long-open but that reflects review churn, not reduced importance

categories.name: wallet
why: P3 because the wallet tool doesn't yet do anything with its new node connection
